name: DeltaVita
description: Unofficial native PS Vita port inspired by Delta: libretro cores, .deltaskin skins in portrait and landscape, PlayStation-style UI
long_description: An unofficial, native **PS Vita take on Delta**, Riley Testut's multi-system iOS emulator. DeltaVita is not affiliated with Delta or Riley Testut. It is a native launcher (vita2d) plus one libretro core per console, each statically linked into its own app and started with `sceAppMgrLoadExec`. Its sister project is DeltaDroid (Android).
